text.KJV: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
text.ASV: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:
text.WEB: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

text.KJV: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
text.ASV: To know wisdom and instruction; To discern the words of understanding;
text.WEB: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

text.KJV: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
text.ASV: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;
text.WEB: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

text.KJV: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
text.ASV: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion:
text.WEB: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:

text.KJV: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
text.ASV: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:
text.WEB: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:

text.KJV: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
text.ASV: To understand a proverb, and a figure, The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
text.WEB: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; `But' the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

text.KJV: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
text.ASV: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:
text.WEB: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:

text.KJV: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
text.ASV: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.
text.WEB: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

text.KJV: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
text.ASV: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.
text.WEB: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

text.KJV: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
text.ASV: If they say, Come with us, Let us lay wait for blood; Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;
text.WEB: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

text.KJV: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
text.ASV: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;
text.WEB: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

text.KJV: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
text.ASV: We shall find all precious substance; We shall fill our houses with spoil;
text.WEB: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

text.KJV: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
text.ASV: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us; We will all have one purse:
text.WEB: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”

text.KJV: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
text.ASV: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:
text.WEB: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

text.KJV: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
text.ASV: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.
text.WEB: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

text.KJV: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
text.ASV: For in vain is the net spread In the sight of any bird:
text.WEB: For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird:

text.KJV: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
text.ASV: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.
text.WEB: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

text.KJV: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
text.ASV: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
text.WEB: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

text.KJV: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
text.ASV: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street; She uttereth her voice in the broad places;
text.WEB: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

text.KJV: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
text.ASV: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:
text.WEB: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

text.KJV: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
text.ASV: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?
text.WEB: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

text.KJV: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
text.ASV: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.
text.WEB: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

text.KJV: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
text.ASV: Because I have called, and ye have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;
text.WEB: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

text.KJV: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
text.ASV: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:
text.WEB: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

text.KJV: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
text.ASV: I also will laugh in `the day of' your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
text.WEB: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you;

text.KJV: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
text.ASV: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.
text.WEB: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind; when distress and anguish come on you.

text.KJV: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
text.ASV: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they shall not find me:
text.WEB: Then will they call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;

text.KJV: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
text.ASV: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of Jehovah:
text.WEB: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

text.KJV: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
text.ASV: They would none of my counsel; They despised all my reproof.
text.WEB: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

text.KJV: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
text.ASV: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.
text.WEB: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

text.KJV: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
text.ASV: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.
text.WEB: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

text.KJV: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
text.ASV: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.
text.WEB: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

text.KJV: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
text.ASV: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And lay up my commandments with thee;
text.WEB: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you;

text.KJV: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
text.ASV: So as to incline thine ear unto wisdom, And apply thy heart to understanding;
text.WEB: So as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

text.KJV: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
text.ASV: Yea, if thou cry after discernment, And lift up thy voice for understanding;
text.WEB: Yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

text.KJV: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
text.ASV: If thou seek her as silver, And search for her as for hid treasures:
text.WEB: If you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:

text.KJV: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
text.ASV: Then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, And find the knowledge of God.
text.WEB: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.

text.KJV: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
text.ASV: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; Out of his mouth `cometh' knowledge and understanding:
text.WEB: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

text.KJV: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
text.ASV: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; `He is' a shield to them that walk in integrity;
text.WEB: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity;

text.KJV: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
text.ASV: That he may guard the paths of justice, And preserve the way of his saints.
text.WEB: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

text.KJV: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
text.ASV: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, `yea', every good path.
text.WEB: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

text.KJV: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
text.ASV: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart, And knowledge shall be pleasant unto thy soul;
text.WEB: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

text.KJV: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
text.ASV: Discretion shall watch over thee; Understanding shall keep thee:
text.WEB: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

text.KJV: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
text.ASV: To deliver thee from the way of evil, From the men that speak perverse things;
text.WEB: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things;

text.KJV: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
text.ASV: Who forsake the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;
text.WEB: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

text.KJV: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
text.ASV: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the perverseness of evil;
text.WEB: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil;

text.KJV: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
text.ASV: Who are crooked in their ways, And wayward in their paths:
text.WEB: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths:

text.KJV: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
text.ASV: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the foreigner that flattereth with her words;
text.WEB: To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words;

text.KJV: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
text.ASV: That forsaketh the friend of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God:
text.WEB: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God:

text.KJV: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
text.ASV: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead;
text.WEB: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

text.KJV: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
text.ASV: None that go unto her return again, Neither do they attain unto the paths of life:
text.WEB: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life:

text.KJV: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
text.ASV: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.
text.WEB: that you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

text.KJV: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
text.ASV: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.
text.WEB: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

text.KJV: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
text.ASV: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the treacherous shall be rooted out of it.
text.WEB: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

text.KJV: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
text.ASV: My son, forget not my law; But let thy heart keep my commandments:
text.WEB: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:

text.KJV: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
text.ASV: For length of days, and years of life, And peace, will they add to thee.
text.WEB: for length of days, and years of life, and peace, will they add to you.

text.KJV: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
text.ASV: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee: Bind them about thy neck; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart:
text.WEB: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

text.KJV: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
text.ASV: So shalt thou find favor and good understanding In the sight of God and man.
text.WEB: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

text.KJV: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
text.ASV: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding:
text.WEB: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

text.KJV: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
text.ASV: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he will direct thy paths.
text.WEB: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

text.KJV: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
text.ASV: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:
text.WEB: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

text.KJV: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
text.ASV: It will be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.
text.WEB: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

text.KJV: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
text.ASV: Honor Jehovah with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase:
text.WEB: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:

text.KJV: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
text.ASV: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy vats shall overflow with new wine.
text.WEB: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

text.KJV: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
text.ASV: My son, despise not the chastening of Jehovah; Neither be weary of his reproof:
text.WEB: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his reproof:

text.KJV: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
text.ASV: For whom Jehovah loveth he reproveth; Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
text.WEB: for whom Yahweh loves, he reproves; even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

text.KJV: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
text.ASV: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that getteth understanding.
text.WEB: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

text.KJV: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
text.ASV: For the gaining of it is better than the gaining of silver, And the profit thereof than fine gold.
text.WEB: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

text.KJV: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
text.ASV: She is more precious than rubies: And none of the things thou canst desire are to be compared unto her.
text.WEB: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

text.KJV: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
text.ASV: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honor.
text.WEB: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

text.KJV: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
text.ASV: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.
text.WEB: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

text.KJV: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
text.ASV: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: And happy is every one that retaineth her.
text.WEB: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

text.KJV: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
text.ASV: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding he established the heavens.
text.WEB: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

text.KJV: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
text.ASV: By his knowledge the depths were broken up, And the skies drop down the dew.
text.WEB: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

text.KJV: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
text.ASV: My son, let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
text.WEB: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:

text.KJV: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
text.ASV: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.
text.WEB: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

text.KJV: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
text.ASV: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thy foot shall not stumble.
text.WEB: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

text.KJV: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
text.ASV: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
text.WEB: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

text.KJV: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
text.ASV: Be not afraid of sudden fear, Neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh:
text.WEB: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes:

text.KJV: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
text.ASV: For Jehovah will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being taken.
text.WEB: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

text.KJV: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
text.ASV: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.
text.WEB: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

text.KJV: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
text.ASV: Say not unto thy neighbor, Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give; When thou hast it by thee.
text.WEB: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

text.KJV: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
text.ASV: Devise not evil against thy neighbor, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
text.WEB: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

text.KJV: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
text.ASV: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.
text.WEB: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

text.KJV: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
text.ASV: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.
text.WEB: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

text.KJV: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
text.ASV: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; But his friendship is with the upright.
text.WEB: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

text.KJV: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
text.ASV: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; But he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

text.KJV: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
text.ASV: Surely he scoffeth at the scoffers; But he giveth grace unto the lowly.
text.WEB: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

text.KJV: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
text.ASV: The wise shall inherit glory; But shame shall be the promotion of fools.
text.WEB: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

text.KJV: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
text.ASV: Hear, `my' sons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:
text.WEB: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

text.KJV: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
text.ASV: For I give you good doctrine; Forsake ye not my law.
text.WEB: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

text.KJV: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
text.ASV: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
text.WEB: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

text.KJV: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
text.ASV: And he taught me, and said unto me: Let thy heart retain my words; Keep my commandments, and live;
text.WEB: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

text.KJV: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
text.ASV: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;
text.WEB: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

text.KJV: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
text.ASV: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.
text.WEB: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

text.KJV: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
text.ASV: Wisdom `is' the principal thing; `therefore' get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.
text.WEB: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

text.KJV: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
text.ASV: Exalt her, and she will promote thee; She will bring thee to honor, when thou dost embrace her.
text.WEB: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor, when you embrace her.

text.KJV: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
text.ASV: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of beauty will she deliver to thee.
text.WEB: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

text.KJV: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
text.ASV: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.
text.WEB: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

text.KJV: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
text.ASV: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.
text.WEB: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

text.KJV: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
text.ASV: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
text.WEB: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

text.KJV: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
text.ASV: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: Keep her; for she is thy life.
text.WEB: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

text.KJV: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
text.ASV: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.
text.WEB: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

text.KJV: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
text.ASV: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.
text.WEB: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

text.KJV: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
text.ASV: For they sleep not, except they do evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
text.WEB: For they don’t sleep, unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

text.KJV: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
text.ASV: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.
text.WEB: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

text.KJV: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
text.ASV: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
text.WEB: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light, that shines more and more until the perfect day.

text.KJV: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
text.ASV: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.
text.WEB: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

text.KJV: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
text.ASV: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.
text.WEB: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

text.KJV: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
text.ASV: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.
text.WEB: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

text.KJV: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
text.ASV: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.
text.WEB: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

text.KJV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
text.ASV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.
text.WEB: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

text.KJV: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
text.ASV: Put away from thee a wayward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.
text.WEB: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

text.KJV: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
text.ASV: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
text.WEB: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

text.KJV: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
text.ASV: Make level the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.
text.WEB: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

text.KJV: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
text.ASV: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.
text.WEB: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

text.KJV: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
text.ASV: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding:
text.WEB: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding:

text.KJV: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
text.ASV: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.
text.WEB: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

text.KJV: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
text.ASV: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil:
text.WEB: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

text.KJV: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
text.ASV: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.
text.WEB: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

text.KJV: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
text.ASV: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on Sheol;
text.WEB: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

text.KJV: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
text.ASV: So that she findeth not the level path of life: Her ways are unstable, `and' she knoweth `it' not.
text.WEB: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

text.KJV: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
text.ASV: Now therefore, `my' sons, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.
text.WEB: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

text.KJV: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
text.ASV: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;
text.WEB: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

text.KJV: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
text.ASV: Lest thou give thine honor unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;
text.WEB: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

text.KJV: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
text.ASV: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labors `be' in the house of an alien,
text.WEB: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

text.KJV: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
text.ASV: And thou mourn at thy latter end, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
text.WEB: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

text.KJV: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
text.ASV: And say, How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;
text.WEB: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

text.KJV: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
text.ASV: Neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
text.WEB: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

text.KJV: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
text.ASV: I was well-nigh in all evil In the midst of the assembly and congregation.
text.WEB: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

text.KJV: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
text.ASV: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.
text.WEB: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

text.KJV: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
text.ASV: Should thy springs be dispersed abroad, And streams of water in the streets?
text.WEB: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

text.KJV: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
text.ASV: Let them be for thyself alone, And not for strangers with thee.
text.WEB: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

text.KJV: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
text.ASV: Let thy fountain be blessed; And rejoice in the wife of thy youth.
text.WEB: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

text.KJV: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
text.ASV: `As' a loving hind and a pleasant doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; And be thou ravished always with her love.
text.WEB: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

text.KJV: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
text.ASV: For why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of a foreigner?
text.WEB: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

text.KJV: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
text.ASV: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah; And he maketh level all his paths.
text.WEB: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

text.KJV: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
text.ASV: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.
text.WEB: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

text.KJV: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
text.ASV: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
text.WEB: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

text.KJV: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
text.ASV: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbor, If thou hast stricken thy hands for a stranger;
text.WEB: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger;

text.KJV: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
text.ASV: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
text.WEB: You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

text.KJV: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
text.ASV: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbor: Go, humble thyself, and importune thy neighbor;
text.WEB: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

text.KJV: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
text.ASV: Give not sleep to thine eyes, Nor slumber to thine eyelids;
text.WEB: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

text.KJV: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
text.ASV: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand `of the hunter', And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
text.WEB: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

text.KJV: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
text.ASV: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise:
text.WEB: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

text.KJV: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
text.ASV: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,
text.WEB: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

text.KJV: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
text.ASV: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.
text.WEB: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

text.KJV: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
text.ASV: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
text.WEB: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

text.KJV: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
text.ASV: `Yet' a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:
text.WEB: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

text.KJV: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
text.ASV: So shall thy poverty come as a robber, And thy want as an armed man.
text.WEB: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

text.KJV: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
text.ASV: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a perverse mouth;
text.WEB: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth;

text.KJV: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
text.ASV: That winketh with his eyes, that speaketh with his feet, That maketh signs with his fingers;
text.WEB: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers;

text.KJV: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
text.ASV: In whose heart is perverseness, Who deviseth evil continually, Who soweth discord.
text.WEB: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

text.KJV: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
text.ASV: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.
text.WEB: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

text.KJV: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
text.ASV: There are six things which Jehovah hateth; Yea, seven which are an abomination unto him:
text.WEB: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

text.KJV: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
text.ASV: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;
text.WEB: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood;

text.KJV: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
text.ASV: A heart that deviseth wicked purposes, Feet that are swift in running to mischief,
text.WEB: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

text.KJV: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
text.ASV: A false witness that uttereth lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.
text.WEB: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

text.KJV: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
text.ASV: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:
text.WEB: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

text.KJV: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
text.ASV: Bind them continually upon thy heart; Tie them about thy neck.
text.WEB: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

text.KJV: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
text.ASV: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
text.WEB: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

text.KJV: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
text.ASV: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
text.WEB: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

text.KJV: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
text.ASV: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the foreigner's tongue.
text.WEB: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

text.KJV: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
text.ASV: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
text.WEB: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

text.KJV: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adultress will hunt for the precious life.
text.ASV: For on account of a harlot `a man is brought' to a piece of bread; And the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.
text.WEB: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

text.KJV: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
text.ASV: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?
text.WEB: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

text.KJV: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
text.ASV: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?
text.WEB: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

text.KJV: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
text.ASV: So he that goeth in to his neighbor's wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be unpunished.
text.WEB: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

text.KJV: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
text.ASV: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy himself when he is hungry:
text.WEB: Men don’t despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry:

text.KJV: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
text.ASV: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; He shall give all the substance of his house.
text.WEB: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

text.KJV: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
text.ASV: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding: He doeth it who would destroy his own soul.
text.WEB: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

text.KJV: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
text.ASV: Wounds and dishonor shall he get; And his reproach shall not be wiped away.
text.WEB: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

text.KJV: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
text.ASV: For jealousy is the rage of a man; And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
text.WEB: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

text.KJV: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
text.ASV: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
text.WEB: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

text.KJV: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
text.ASV: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.
text.WEB: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

text.KJV: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
text.ASV: Keep my commandments and live; And my law as the apple of thine eye.
text.WEB: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

text.KJV: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
text.ASV: Bind them upon thy fingers; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart.
text.WEB: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

text.KJV: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
text.ASV: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; And call understanding `thy' kinswoman:
text.WEB: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

text.KJV: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
text.ASV: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the foreigner that flattereth with her words.
text.WEB: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

text.KJV: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
text.ASV: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;
text.WEB: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

text.KJV: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
text.ASV: And I beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,
text.WEB: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

text.KJV: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
text.ASV: Passing through the street near her corner; And he went the way to her house,
text.WEB: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

text.KJV: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
text.ASV: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the middle of the night and in the darkness.
text.WEB: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

text.KJV: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
text.ASV: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.
text.WEB: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

text.KJV: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
text.ASV: She is clamorous and wilful; Her feet abide not in her house:
text.WEB: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

text.KJV: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
text.ASV: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.
text.WEB: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

text.KJV: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
text.ASV: So she caught him, and kissed him, `And' with an impudent face she said unto him:
text.WEB: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

text.KJV: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
text.ASV: Sacrifices of peace-offerings are with me; This day have I paid my vows.
text.WEB: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

text.KJV: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
text.ASV: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
text.WEB: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

text.KJV: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
text.ASV: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
text.WEB: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

text.KJV: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
text.ASV: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
text.WEB: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

text.KJV: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
text.ASV: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.
text.WEB: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

text.KJV: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
text.ASV: For the man is not at home; He is gone a long journey:
text.WEB: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

text.KJV: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
text.ASV: He hath taken a bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.
text.WEB: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

text.KJV: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
text.ASV: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield; With the flattering of her lips she forceth him along.
text.WEB: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

text.KJV: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
text.ASV: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or as `one in' fetters to the correction of the fool;
text.WEB: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

text.KJV: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
text.ASV: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.
text.WEB: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

text.KJV: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
text.ASV: Now therefore, `my' sons, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.
text.WEB: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

text.KJV: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
text.ASV: Let not thy heart decline to her ways; Go not astray in her paths.
text.WEB: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

text.KJV: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
text.ASV: For she hath cast down many wounded: Yea, all her slain are a mighty host.
text.WEB: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

text.KJV: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
text.ASV: Her house is the way to Sheol, Going down to the chambers of death.
text.WEB: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

text.KJV: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
text.ASV: Doth not wisdom cry, And understanding put forth her voice?
text.WEB: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

text.KJV: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
text.ASV: On the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;
text.WEB: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

text.KJV: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
text.ASV: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:
text.WEB: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

text.KJV: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
text.ASV: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of men.
text.WEB: “To you men, I call! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

text.KJV: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
text.ASV: O ye simple, understand prudence; And, ye fools, be of an understanding heart.
text.WEB: You simple, understand prudence. You fools, be of an understanding heart.

text.KJV: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
text.ASV: Hear, for I will speak excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.
text.WEB: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

text.KJV: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
text.ASV: For my mouth shall utter truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
text.WEB: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

text.KJV: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
text.ASV: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
text.WEB: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

text.KJV: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
text.ASV: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.
text.WEB: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

text.KJV: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
text.ASV: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.
text.WEB: Receive my instruction rather than silver; knowledge rather than choice gold.

text.KJV: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
text.ASV: For wisdom is better than rubies; And all the things that may be desired are not to be compared unto it.
text.WEB: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

text.KJV: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
text.ASV: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling, And find out knowledge `and' discretion.
text.WEB: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the perverse mouth, do I hate.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

text.KJV: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
text.ASV: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge: I am understanding; I have might.
text.WEB: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

text.KJV: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
text.ASV: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.
text.WEB: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

text.KJV: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
text.ASV: By me princes rule, And nobles, `even' all the judges of the earth.
text.WEB: By me princes rule; nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

text.KJV: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
text.ASV: I love them that love me; And those that seek me diligently shall find me.
text.WEB: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

text.KJV: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
text.ASV: Riches and honor are with me; `Yea', durable wealth and righteousness.
text.WEB: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

text.KJV: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
text.ASV: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.
text.WEB: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold; my yield than choice silver.

text.KJV: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
text.ASV: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;
text.WEB: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice;

text.KJV: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
text.ASV: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.
text.WEB: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

text.KJV: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
text.ASV: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.
text.WEB: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

text.KJV: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
text.ASV: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Before the earth was.
text.WEB: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

text.KJV: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
text.ASV: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.
text.WEB: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

text.KJV: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
text.ASV: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;
text.WEB: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

text.KJV: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
text.ASV: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
text.WEB: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

text.KJV: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
text.ASV: When he established the heavens, I was there: When he set a circle upon the face of the deep,
text.WEB: When he established the heavens, I was there; when he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

text.KJV: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
text.ASV: When he made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep became strong,
text.WEB: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

text.KJV: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
text.ASV: When he gave to the sea its bound, That the waters should not transgress his commandment, When he marked out the foundations of the earth;
text.WEB: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth;

text.KJV: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
text.ASV: Then I was by him, `as' a master workman; And I was daily `his' delight, Rejoicing always before him,
text.WEB: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

text.KJV: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
text.ASV: Rejoicing in his habitable earth; And my delight was with the sons of men.
text.WEB: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

text.KJV: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
text.ASV: Now therefore, `my' sons, hearken unto me; For blessed are they that keep my ways.
text.WEB: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

text.KJV: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
text.ASV: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.
text.WEB: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

text.KJV: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
text.ASV: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.
text.WEB: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

text.KJV: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
text.ASV: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favor of Jehovah.
text.WEB: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

text.KJV: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
text.ASV: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: All they that hate me love death.
text.WEB: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

text.KJV: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
text.ASV: Wisdom hath builded her house; She hath hewn out her seven pillars:
text.WEB: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

text.KJV: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
text.ASV: She hath killed her beasts; She hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table:
text.WEB: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

text.KJV: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
text.ASV: She hath sent forth her maidens; She crieth upon the highest places of the city:
text.WEB: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

text.KJV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
text.ASV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: As for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,
text.WEB: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

text.KJV: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
text.ASV: Come, eat ye of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.
text.WEB: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

text.KJV: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
text.ASV: Leave off, ye simple ones, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.
text.WEB: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

text.KJV: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
text.ASV: He that correcteth a scoffer getteth to himself reviling; And he that reproveth a wicked man `getteth' himself a blot.
text.WEB: He who corrects a mocker invites insult. He who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

text.KJV: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
text.ASV: Reprove not a scoffer, lest he hate thee: Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.
text.WEB: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise man, and he will love you.

text.KJV: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
text.ASV: Give `instruction' to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
text.WEB: Instruct a wise man, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

text.KJV: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
text.ASV: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.
text.WEB: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

text.KJV: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
text.ASV: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scoffest, thou alone shalt bear it.
text.WEB: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

text.KJV: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
text.ASV: The foolish woman is clamorous; `She is' simple, and knoweth nothing.
text.WEB: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

text.KJV: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
text.ASV: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,
text.WEB: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

text.KJV: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
text.ASV: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:
text.WEB: To call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

text.KJV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
text.ASV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither; And as for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,
text.WEB: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

text.KJV: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
text.ASV: Stolen waters are sweet, And bread `eaten' in secret is pleasant.
text.WEB: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

text.KJV: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
text.ASV: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
text.WEB: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

text.KJV: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
text.ASV: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
text.WEB: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

text.KJV: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
text.ASV: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; But righteousness delivereth from death.
text.WEB: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

text.KJV: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
text.ASV: Jehovah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But he thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.
text.WEB: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

text.KJV: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
text.ASV: He becometh poor that worketh with a slack hand; But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
text.WEB: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

text.KJV: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
text.ASV: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son; `But' he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
text.WEB: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

text.KJV: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
text.ASV: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
text.WEB: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

text.KJV: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
text.ASV: The memory of the righteous is blessed; But the name of the wicked shall rot.
text.WEB: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

text.KJV: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
text.ASV: The wise in heart will receive commandments; But a prating fool shall fall.
text.WEB: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

text.KJV: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
text.ASV: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
text.WEB: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

text.KJV: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
text.ASV: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; But a prating fool shall fall.
text.WEB: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

text.KJV: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
text.ASV: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
text.WEB: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

text.KJV: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
text.ASV: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.
text.WEB: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

text.KJV: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
text.ASV: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
text.WEB: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

text.KJV: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
text.ASV: Wise men lay up knowledge; But the mouth of the foolish is a present destruction.
text.WEB: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

text.KJV: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
text.ASV: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
text.WEB: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

text.KJV: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
text.ASV: The labor of the righteous `tendeth' to life; The increase of the wicked, to sin.
text.WEB: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

text.KJV: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
text.ASV: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.
text.WEB: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

text.KJV: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
text.ASV: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.
text.WEB: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

text.KJV: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
text.ASV: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips doeth wisely.
text.WEB: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

text.KJV: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
text.ASV: The tongue of the righteous is `as' choice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.
text.WEB: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

text.KJV: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
text.ASV: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for lack of understanding.
text.WEB: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

text.KJV: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
text.ASV: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

text.KJV: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
text.ASV: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness; And `so is' wisdom to a man of understanding.
text.WEB: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

text.KJV: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
text.ASV: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
text.WEB: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

text.KJV: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
text.ASV: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
text.WEB: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

text.KJV: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
text.ASV: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.
text.WEB: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

text.KJV: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
text.ASV: The hope of the righteous `shall be' gladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
text.WEB: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

text.KJV: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
text.ASV: The way of Jehovah is a stronghold to the upright; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
text.WEB: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

text.KJV: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
text.ASV: The righteous shall never be removed; But the wicked shall not dwell in the land.
text.WEB: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

text.KJV: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
text.ASV: The mouth of the righteous bringeth forth wisdom; But the perverse tongue shall be cut off.
text.WEB: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

text.KJV: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
text.ASV: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wicked `speaketh' perverseness.
text.WEB: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

text.KJV: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
