text.ASV: A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; But a just weight is his delight.
text.WEB: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

text.KJV: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
text.ASV: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.
text.WEB: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

text.KJV: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
text.ASV: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
text.WEB: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

text.KJV: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
text.ASV: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.
text.WEB: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

text.KJV: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
text.ASV: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
text.WEB: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

text.KJV: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
text.ASV: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the treacherous shall be taken in their own iniquity.
text.WEB: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

text.KJV: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
text.ASV: When a wicked man dieth, `his' expectation shall perish; And the hope of iniquity perisheth.
text.WEB: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

text.KJV: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
text.ASV: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, And the wicked cometh in his stead.
text.WEB: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

text.KJV: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
text.ASV: With his mouth the godless man destroyeth his neighbor; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.
text.WEB: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

text.KJV: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
text.ASV: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
text.WEB: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

text.KJV: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
text.ASV: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
text.WEB: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

text.KJV: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
text.ASV: He that despiseth his neighbor is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
text.WEB: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

text.KJV: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
text.ASV: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.
text.WEB: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

text.KJV: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
text.ASV: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
text.WEB: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

text.KJV: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
text.ASV: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth suretyship is secure.
text.WEB: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

text.KJV: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
text.ASV: A gracious woman obtaineth honor; And violent men obtain riches.
text.WEB: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

text.KJV: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
text.ASV: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
text.WEB: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

text.KJV: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
text.ASV: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness `hath' a sure reward.
text.WEB: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

text.KJV: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
text.ASV: He that is stedfast in righteousness `shall attain' unto life; And he that pursueth evil `doeth it' to his own death.
text.WEB: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

text.KJV: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
text.ASV: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to Jehovah; But such as are perfect in `their' way are his delight.
text.WEB: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

text.KJV: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
text.ASV: `Though' hand `join' in hand, the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
text.WEB: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

text.KJV: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
text.ASV: `As' a ring of gold in a swine's snout, `So is' a fair woman that is without discretion.
text.WEB: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

text.KJV: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
text.ASV: The desire of the righteous is only good; `But' the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
text.WEB: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

text.KJV: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
text.ASV: There is that scattereth, and increaseth yet more; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but `it tendeth' only to want.
text.WEB: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

text.KJV: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
text.ASV: The liberal soul shall be made fat; And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
text.WEB: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

text.KJV: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
text.ASV: He that withholdeth grain, the people shall curse him; But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
text.WEB: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

text.KJV: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
text.ASV: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favor; But he that searcheth after evil, it shall come unto him.
text.WEB: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

text.KJV: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
text.ASV: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
text.WEB: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

text.KJV: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
text.ASV: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind; And the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
text.WEB: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

text.KJV: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
text.ASV: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that is wise winneth souls.
text.WEB: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

text.KJV: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
text.ASV: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: How much more the wicked and the sinner!
text.WEB: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth; how much more the wicked and the sinner!

text.KJV: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
text.ASV: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.
text.WEB: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

text.KJV: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
text.ASV: A good man shall obtain favor of Jehovah; But a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
text.WEB: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

text.KJV: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
text.ASV: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
text.WEB: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

text.KJV: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
text.ASV: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband; But she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
text.WEB: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

text.KJV: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
text.ASV: The thoughts of the righteous are just; `But' the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
text.WEB: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

text.KJV: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
text.ASV: The words of the wicked are of lying in wait for blood; But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
text.WEB: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

text.KJV: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
text.ASV: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.
text.WEB: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

text.KJV: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
text.ASV: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom; But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
text.WEB: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

text.KJV: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
text.ASV: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that honoreth himself, and lacketh bread.
text.WEB: Better is he who is little know, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.

text.KJV: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
text.ASV: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast; But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
text.WEB: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

text.KJV: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
text.ASV: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain `persons' is void of understanding.
text.WEB: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

text.KJV: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
text.ASV: The wicked desireth the net of evil men; But the root of the righteous yieldeth `fruit'.
text.WEB: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

text.KJV: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
text.ASV: In the transgression of the lips is a snare to the evil man; But the righteous shall come out of trouble.
text.WEB: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

text.KJV: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
text.ASV: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; And the doings of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
text.WEB: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

text.KJV: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
text.ASV: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.
text.WEB: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

text.KJV: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
text.ASV: A fool's vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.
text.WEB: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

text.KJV: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
text.ASV: He that uttereth truth showeth forth righteousness; But a false witness, deceit.
text.WEB: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

text.KJV: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
text.ASV: There is that speaketh rashly like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.
text.WEB: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

text.KJV: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
text.ASV: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
text.WEB: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

text.KJV: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
text.ASV: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.
text.WEB: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

text.KJV: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
text.ASV: There shall no mischief happen to the righteous; But the wicked shall be filled with evil.
text.WEB: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

text.KJV: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
text.ASV: Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; But they that deal truly are his delight.
text.WEB: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

text.KJV: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
text.ASV: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
text.WEB: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

text.KJV: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
text.ASV: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be put under taskwork.
text.WEB: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

text.KJV: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
text.ASV: Heaviness in the heart of a man maketh it stoop; But a good word maketh it glad.
text.WEB: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

text.KJV: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
text.ASV: The righteous is a guide to his neighbor; But the way of the wicked causeth them to err.
text.WEB: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

text.KJV: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
text.ASV: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting; But the precious substance of men `is to' the diligent.
text.WEB: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

text.KJV: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
text.ASV: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.
text.WEB: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

text.KJV: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
text.ASV: A wise son `heareth' his father's instruction; But a scoffer heareth not rebuke.
text.WEB: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

text.KJV: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
text.ASV: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; But the soul of the treacherous `shall eat' violence.
text.WEB: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things; but the unfaithful crave violence.

text.KJV: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
text.ASV: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; `But' he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
text.WEB: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

text.KJV: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
text.ASV: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
text.WEB: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

text.KJV: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
text.ASV: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
text.WEB: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

text.KJV: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
text.ASV: Righteousness guardeth him that is upright in the way; But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
text.WEB: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

text.KJV: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
text.ASV: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: There is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great wealth.
text.WEB: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

text.KJV: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
text.ASV: The ransom of a man's life is his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.
text.WEB: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

text.KJV: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
text.ASV: The light of the righteous rejoiceth; But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
text.WEB: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

text.KJV: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
text.ASV: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.
text.WEB: Pride only breeds quarrels, but with ones who take advice is wisdom.

text.KJV: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
text.ASV: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.
text.WEB: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

text.KJV: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
text.ASV: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
text.WEB: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

text.KJV: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
text.ASV: Whoso despiseth the word bringeth destruction on himself; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
text.WEB: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

text.KJV: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
text.ASV: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.
text.WEB: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

text.KJV: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
text.ASV: Good understanding giveth favor; But the way of the transgressor is hard.
text.WEB: Good understanding wins favor; but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

text.KJV: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
text.ASV: Every prudent man worketh with knowledge; But a fool flaunteth `his' folly.
text.WEB: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

text.KJV: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
text.ASV: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.
text.WEB: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

text.KJV: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
text.ASV: Poverty and shame `shall be to' him that refuseth correction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honored.
text.WEB: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

text.KJV: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
text.ASV: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.
text.WEB: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

text.KJV: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
text.ASV: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.
text.WEB: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

text.KJV: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
text.ASV: Evil pursueth sinners; But the righteous shall be recompensed with good.
text.WEB: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

text.KJV: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
text.ASV: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children; And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous.
text.WEB: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

text.KJV: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
text.ASV: Much food `is in' the tillage of the poor; But there is that is destroyed by reason of injustice.
text.WEB: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

text.KJV: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
text.ASV: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
text.WEB: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

text.KJV: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
text.ASV: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul; But the belly of the wicked shall want.
text.WEB: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

text.KJV: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
text.ASV: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her own hands.
text.WEB: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

text.KJV: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
text.ASV: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
text.WEB: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

text.KJV: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
text.ASV: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod for `his' pride; But the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
text.WEB: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

text.KJV: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
text.ASV: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.
text.WEB: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

text.KJV: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
text.ASV: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness uttereth lies.
text.WEB: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

text.KJV: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
text.ASV: A scoffer seeketh wisdom, and `findeth it' not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath understanding.
text.WEB: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

text.KJV: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
text.ASV: Go into the presence of a foolish man, And thou shalt not perceive `in him' the lips of knowledge.
text.WEB: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

text.KJV: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
text.ASV: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.
text.WEB: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

text.KJV: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
text.ASV: A trespass-offering mocketh fools; But among the upright there is good will.
text.WEB: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

text.KJV: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
text.ASV: The heart knoweth its own bitterness; And a stranger doth not intermeddle with its joy.
text.WEB: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

text.KJV: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
text.ASV: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.
text.WEB: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

text.KJV: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
text.ASV: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.
text.WEB: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

text.KJV: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
text.ASV: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; And the end of mirth is heaviness.
text.WEB: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

text.KJV: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
text.ASV: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways; And a good man `shall be satisfied' from himself.
text.WEB: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

text.KJV: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
text.ASV: The simple believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.
text.WEB: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

text.KJV: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
text.ASV: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool beareth himself insolently, and is confident.
text.WEB: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

text.KJV: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
text.ASV: He that is soon angry will deal foolishly; And a man of wicked devices is hated.
text.WEB: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

text.KJV: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
text.ASV: The simple inherit folly; But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
text.WEB: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

text.KJV: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
text.ASV: The evil bow down before the good; And the wicked, at the gates of the righteous.
text.WEB: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

text.KJV: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
text.ASV: The poor is hated even of his own neighbor; But the rich hath many friends.
text.WEB: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

text.KJV: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
text.ASV: He that despiseth his neighbor sinneth; But he that hath pity on the poor, happy is he.
text.WEB: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who has pity on the poor.

text.KJV: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
text.ASV: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth `shall be to' them that devise good.
text.WEB: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

text.KJV: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
text.ASV: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lips `tendeth' only to penury.
text.WEB: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

text.KJV: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
text.ASV: The crown of the wise is their riches; `But' the folly of fools is `only' folly.
text.WEB: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

text.KJV: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
text.ASV: A true witness delivereth souls; But he that uttereth lies `causeth' deceit.
text.WEB: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

text.KJV: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
text.ASV: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.
text.WEB: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

text.KJV: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
text.ASV: In the multitude of people is the king's glory; But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
text.WEB: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

text.KJV: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
text.ASV: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
text.WEB: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

text.KJV: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
text.ASV: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.
text.WEB: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

text.KJV: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
text.ASV: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; But he that hath mercy on the needy honoreth him.
text.WEB: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

text.KJV: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
text.ASV: The wicked is thrust down in his evil-doing; But the righteous hath a refuge in his death.
text.WEB: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

text.KJV: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
text.ASV: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding; But `that which is' in the inward part of fools is made known.
text.WEB: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

text.KJV: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
text.ASV: Righteousness exalteth a nation; But sin is a reproach to any people.
text.WEB: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

text.KJV: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
text.ASV: The king's favor is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath will be `against' him that causeth shame.
text.WEB: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

text.KJV: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
text.ASV: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.
text.WEB: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

text.KJV: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
text.ASV: The tongue of the wise uttereth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out folly.
text.WEB: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.

text.KJV: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
text.ASV: The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

text.KJV: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
text.ASV: A gentle tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a breaking of the spirit.
text.WEB: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

text.KJV: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
text.ASV: A fool despiseth his father's correction; But he that regardeth reproof getteth prudence.
text.WEB: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

text.KJV: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
text.ASV: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
text.WEB: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

text.KJV: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
text.ASV: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish `doeth' not so.
text.WEB: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

text.KJV: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
text.ASV: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But the prayer of the upright is his delight.
text.WEB: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

text.KJV: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
text.ASV: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
text.WEB: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

text.KJV: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
text.ASV: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; `And' he that hateth reproof shall die.
text.WEB: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.

text.KJV: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
text.ASV: Sheol and Abaddon are before Jehovah: How much more then the hearts of the children of men!
text.WEB: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

text.KJV: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
text.ASV: A scoffer loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.
text.WEB: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

text.KJV: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
text.ASV: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.
text.WEB: A glad heart makes a cheerful face; but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

text.KJV: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
text.ASV: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.
text.WEB: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

text.KJV: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
text.ASV: All the days of the afflicted are evil; But he that is of a cheerful heart `hath' a continual feast.
text.WEB: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

text.KJV: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
text.ASV: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.
text.WEB: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.

text.KJV: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
text.ASV: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
text.WEB: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

text.KJV: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
text.ASV: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
text.WEB: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

text.KJV: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
text.ASV: The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; But the path of the upright is made a highway.
text.WEB: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

text.KJV: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
text.ASV: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.
text.WEB: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

text.KJV: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
text.ASV: Folly is joy to him that is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding maketh straight his going.
text.WEB: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

text.KJV: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
text.ASV: Where there is no counsel, purposes are disappointed; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
text.WEB: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

text.KJV: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
text.ASV: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!
text.WEB: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

text.KJV: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
text.ASV: To the wise the way of life `goeth' upward, That he may depart from Sheol beneath.
text.WEB: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

text.KJV: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
text.ASV: Jehovah will root up the house of the proud; But he will establish the border of the widow.
text.WEB: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

text.KJV: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
text.ASV: Evil devices are an abomination to Jehovah; But pleasant words `are' pure.
text.WEB: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

text.KJV: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
text.ASV: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth bribes shall live.
text.WEB: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

text.KJV: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
text.ASV: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
text.WEB: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

text.KJV: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
text.ASV: Jehovah is far from the wicked; But he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
text.WEB: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

text.KJV: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
text.ASV: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; `And' good tidings make the bones fat.
text.WEB: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

text.KJV: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
text.ASV: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life Shall abide among the wise.
text.WEB: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

text.KJV: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
text.ASV: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.
text.WEB: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the instruction of wisdom; And before honor `goeth' humility.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

text.KJV: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
text.ASV: The plans of the heart belong to man; But the answer of the tongue is from Jehovah.
text.WEB: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

text.KJV: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
text.ASV: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the spirits.
text.WEB: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.

text.KJV: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
text.ASV: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.
text.WEB: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

text.KJV: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath made everything for its own end; Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
text.WEB: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

text.KJV: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
text.ASV: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Jehovah: `Though' hand `join' in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
text.WEB: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.

text.KJV: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
text.ASV: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for; And by the fear of Jehovah men depart from evil.
text.WEB: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

text.KJV: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
text.ASV: When a man's ways please Jehovah, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
text.WEB: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

text.KJV: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
text.ASV: Better is a little, with righteousness, Than great revenues with injustice.
text.WEB: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

text.KJV: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
text.ASV: A man's heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.
text.WEB: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

text.KJV: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
text.ASV: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth shall not transgress in judgment.
text.WEB: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

text.KJV: A just weight and balance are the LORD's: all the weights of the bag are his work.
text.ASV: A just balance and scales are Jehovah's; All the weights of the bag are his work.
text.WEB: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

text.KJV: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
text.ASV: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; For the throne is established by righteousness.
text.WEB: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

text.KJV: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
text.ASV: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.
text.WEB: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

text.KJV: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
text.ASV: The wrath of a king is `as' messengers of death; But a wise man will pacify it.
text.WEB: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

text.KJV: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
text.ASV: In the light of the king's countenance is life; And his favor is as a cloud of the latter rain.
text.WEB: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

text.KJV: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
text.ASV: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! Yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.
text.WEB: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

text.KJV: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
text.ASV: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
text.WEB: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

text.KJV: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
text.ASV: Pride `goeth' before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.
text.WEB: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.

text.KJV: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
text.ASV: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.
text.WEB: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

text.KJV: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
text.ASV: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in Jehovah, happy is he.
text.WEB: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

text.KJV: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
text.ASV: The wise in heart shall be called prudent; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
text.WEB: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

text.KJV: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
text.ASV: Understanding is a well-spring of life unto him that hath it; But the correction of fools is `their' folly.
text.WEB: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

text.KJV: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
text.ASV: The heart of the wise instructeth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.
text.WEB: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

text.KJV: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
text.ASV: Pleasant words are `as' a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
text.WEB: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

text.KJV: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
text.ASV: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.
text.WEB: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

text.KJV: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
text.ASV: The appetite of the laboring man laboreth for him; For his mouth urgeth him `thereto'.
text.WEB: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.

text.KJV: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
text.ASV: A worthless man deviseth mischief; And in his lips there is as a scorching fire.
text.WEB: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

text.KJV: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
text.ASV: A perverse man scattereth abroad strife; And a whisperer separateth chief friends.
text.WEB: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

text.KJV: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
text.ASV: A man of violence enticeth his neighbor, And leadeth him in a way that is not good.
text.WEB: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

text.KJV: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
text.ASV: He that shutteth his eyes, `it is' to devise perverse things: He that compresseth his lips bringeth evil to pass.
text.WEB: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

text.KJV: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
text.ASV: The hoary head is a crown of glory; It shall be found in the way of righteousness.
text.WEB: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

text.KJV: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
text.ASV: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit, than he that taketh a city.
text.WEB: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

text.KJV: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
text.ASV: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of Jehovah.
text.WEB: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.

text.KJV: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
text.ASV: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.
text.WEB: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

text.KJV: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
text.ASV: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, And shall have part in the inheritance among the brethren.
text.WEB: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

text.KJV: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
text.ASV: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; But Jehovah trieth the hearts.
text.WEB: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.

text.KJV: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
text.ASV: An evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; `And' a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.
text.WEB: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

text.KJV: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
text.ASV: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker; `And' he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
text.WEB: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

text.KJV: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
text.ASV: Children's children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.
text.WEB: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.

text.KJV: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
text.ASV: Excellent speech becometh not a fool; Much less do lying lips a prince.
text.WEB: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

text.KJV: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
text.ASV: A bribe is `as' a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; Whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
text.WEB: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

text.KJV: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
text.ASV: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter separateth chief friends.
text.WEB: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

text.KJV: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
text.ASV: A rebuke entereth deeper into one that hath understanding Than a hundred stripes into a fool.
text.WEB: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

text.KJV: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
text.ASV: An evil man seeketh only rebellion; Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
text.WEB: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

text.KJV: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
text.ASV: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.
text.WEB: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

text.KJV: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
text.ASV: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.
text.WEB: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

text.KJV: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
text.ASV: The beginning of strife is `as' when one letteth out water: Therefore leave off contention, before there is quarrelling.
text.WEB: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

text.KJV: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
text.ASV: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.
text.WEB: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
text.ASV: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, Seeing he hath no understanding?
text.WEB: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

text.KJV: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
text.ASV: A friend loveth at all times; And a brother is born for adversity.
text.WEB: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

text.KJV: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
text.ASV: A man void of understanding striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbor.
text.WEB: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

text.KJV: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
text.ASV: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: He that raiseth high his gate seeketh destruction.
text.WEB: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

text.KJV: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
text.ASV: He that hath a wayward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
text.WEB: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

text.KJV: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
text.ASV: He that begetteth a fool `doeth it' to his sorrow; And the father of a fool hath no joy.
text.WEB: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

text.KJV: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
text.ASV: A cheerful heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth up the bones.
text.WEB: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

text.KJV: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
text.ASV: A wicked man receiveth a bribe out of the bosom, To pervert the ways of justice.
text.WEB: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

text.KJV: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
text.ASV: Wisdom is before the face of him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
text.WEB: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

text.KJV: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
text.ASV: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her that bare him.
text.WEB: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

text.KJV: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
text.ASV: Also to punish the righteous is not good, `Nor' to smite the noble for `their' uprightness.
text.WEB: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

text.KJV: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
text.ASV: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that is of a cool spirit is a man of understanding.
text.WEB: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

text.KJV: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
text.ASV: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; When he shutteth his lips, he is `esteemed as' prudent.
text.WEB: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

text.KJV: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
text.ASV: He that separateth himself seeketh `his own' desire, And rageth against all sound wisdom.
text.WEB: An unfriendly man pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

text.KJV: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
text.ASV: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may reveal itself.
text.WEB: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

text.KJV: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
text.ASV: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, And with ignominy `cometh' reproach.
text.WEB: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

text.KJV: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
text.ASV: The words of a man's mouth are `as' deep waters; The wellspring of wisdom is `as' a flowing brook.
text.WEB: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

text.KJV: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
text.ASV: To respect the person of the wicked is not good, `Nor' to turn aside the righteous in judgment.
text.WEB: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

text.KJV: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
text.ASV: A fool's lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for stripes.
text.WEB: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

text.KJV: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
text.ASV: A fool's mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.
text.WEB: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

text.KJV: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
text.ASV: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.
text.WEB: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

text.KJV: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
text.ASV: He also that is slack in his work Is brother to him that is a destroyer.
text.WEB: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

text.KJV: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
text.ASV: The name of Jehovah is a strong tower; The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

text.KJV: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
text.ASV: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own imagination.
text.WEB: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

text.KJV: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
text.ASV: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty; And before honor `goeth' humility.
text.WEB: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

text.KJV: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
text.ASV: He that giveth answer before he heareth, It is folly and shame unto him.
text.WEB: He who gives answer before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

text.KJV: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
text.ASV: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?
text.WEB: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

text.KJV: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
text.ASV: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
text.WEB: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

text.KJV: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
text.ASV: A man's gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.
text.WEB: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

text.KJV: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
text.ASV: He that pleadeth his cause first `seemeth' just; But his neighbor cometh and searcheth him out.
text.WEB: He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.

text.KJV: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
text.ASV: The lot causeth contentions to cease, And parteth between the mighty.
text.WEB: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

text.KJV: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
text.ASV: A brother offended `is harder to be won' than a strong city; And `such' contentions are like the bars of a castle.
text.WEB: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city; and disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

text.KJV: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
text.ASV: A man's belly shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth; With the increase of his lips shall he be satisfied.
text.WEB: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

text.KJV: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
text.ASV: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; And they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
text.WEB: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

text.KJV: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
text.ASV: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, And obtaineth favor of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.

text.KJV: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
text.ASV: The poor useth entreaties; But the rich answereth roughly.
text.WEB: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

text.KJV: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
text.ASV: He that maketh many friends `doeth it' to his own destruction; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
text.WEB: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

text.KJV: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
text.ASV: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity Than he that is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
text.WEB: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

text.KJV: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
text.ASV: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
text.WEB: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge; nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.

text.KJV: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
text.ASV: The foolishness of man subverteth his way; And his heart fretteth against Jehovah.
text.WEB: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.

text.KJV: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
text.ASV: Wealth addeth many friends; But the poor is separated from his friend.
text.WEB: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

text.KJV: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
text.ASV: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall not escape.
text.WEB: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

text.KJV: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
text.ASV: Many will entreat the favor of the liberal man; And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
text.WEB: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

text.KJV: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
text.ASV: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: How much more do his friends go far from him! He pursueth `them with' words, `but' they are gone.
text.WEB: All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

text.KJV: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
text.ASV: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: He that keepeth understanding shall find good.
text.WEB: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

text.KJV: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
text.ASV: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall perish.
text.WEB: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

text.KJV: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
text.ASV: Delicate living is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
text.WEB: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

text.KJV: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
text.ASV: The discretion of a man maketh him slow to anger; And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
text.WEB: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

text.KJV: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
text.ASV: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; But his favor is as dew upon the grass.
text.WEB: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

text.KJV: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
text.ASV: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
text.WEB: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

text.KJV: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
text.ASV: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers; But a prudent wife is from Jehovah.
text.WEB: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.

text.KJV: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
text.ASV: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; And the idle soul shall suffer hunger.
text.WEB: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

text.KJV: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
text.ASV: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; `But' he that is careless of his ways shall die.
text.WEB: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

text.KJV: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
text.ASV: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto Jehovah, And his good deed will he pay him again.
text.WEB: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.

text.KJV: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
text.ASV: Chasten thy son, seeing there is hope; nd set not thy heart on his destruction.
text.WEB: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

text.KJV: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
text.ASV: A man of great wrath shall bear the penalty; For if thou deliver `him', thou must do it yet again.
text.WEB: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

text.KJV: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
text.ASV: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
text.WEB: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

text.KJV: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
text.ASV: There are many devices in a man's heart; But the counsel of Jehovah, that shall stand.
text.WEB: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

text.KJV: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
text.ASV: That which maketh a man to be desired is his kindness; And a poor man is better than a liar.
text.WEB: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah `tendeth' to life; And he `that hath it' shall abide satisfied; He shall not be visited with evil.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

text.KJV: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
text.ASV: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
text.WEB: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

text.KJV: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
text.ASV: Smite a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; And reprove one that hath understanding, `and' he will understand knowledge.
text.WEB: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

text.KJV: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
text.ASV: He that doeth violence to his father, and chaseth away his mother, Is a son that causeth shame and bringeth reproach.
text.WEB: He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

text.KJV: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
text.ASV: Cease, my son, to hear instruction `Only' to err from the words of knowledge.
text.WEB: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

text.KJV: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
text.ASV: A worthless witness mocketh at justice; And the mouth of the wicked swalloweth iniquity.
text.WEB: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

text.KJV: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
text.ASV: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And stripes for the back of fools.
text.WEB: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

text.KJV: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
text.ASV: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler; And whosoever erreth thereby is not wise.
text.WEB: Wine is a mocker, and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

text.KJV: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
text.ASV: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: He that provoketh him to anger sinneth `against' his own life.
