text.WEB: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

text.KJV: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
text.ASV: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; But he that keepeth company with harlots wasteth `his' substance.
text.WEB: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

text.KJV: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
text.ASV: The king by justice establisheth the land; But he that exacteth gifts overthroweth it.
text.WEB: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

text.KJV: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
text.ASV: A man that flattereth his neighbor Spreadeth a net for his steps.
text.WEB: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

text.KJV: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
text.ASV: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; But the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
text.WEB: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

text.KJV: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
text.ASV: The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; The wicked hath not understanding to know `it'.
text.WEB: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

text.KJV: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
text.ASV: Scoffers set a city in a flame; But wise men turn away wrath.
text.WEB: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

text.KJV: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
text.ASV: If a wise man hath a controversy with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.
text.WEB: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

text.KJV: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
text.ASV: The bloodthirsty hate him that is perfect; And as for the upright, they seek his life.
text.WEB: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

text.KJV: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
text.ASV: A fool uttereth all his anger; But a wise man keepeth it back and stilleth it.
text.WEB: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

text.KJV: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
text.ASV: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, All his servants are wicked.
text.WEB: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

text.KJV: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
text.ASV: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; Jehovah lighteneth the eyes of them both.
text.WEB: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.

text.KJV: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
text.ASV: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.
text.WEB: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

text.KJV: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
text.ASV: The rod and reproof give wisdom; But a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.
text.WEB: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

text.KJV: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
text.ASV: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; But the righteous shall look upon their fall.
text.WEB: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

text.KJV: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
text.ASV: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; Yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.
text.WEB: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

text.KJV: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
text.ASV: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
text.WEB: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

text.KJV: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
text.ASV: A servant will not be corrected by words; For though he understand, he will not give heed.
text.WEB: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

text.KJV: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
text.ASV: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? There is more hope of a fool than of him.
text.WEB: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

text.KJV: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
text.ASV: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become a son at the last.
text.WEB: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

text.KJV: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
text.ASV: An angry man stirreth up strife, And a wrathful man aboundeth in transgression.
text.WEB: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

text.KJV: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
text.ASV: A man's pride shall bring him low; But he that is of a lowly spirit shall obtain honor.
text.WEB: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

text.KJV: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
text.ASV: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul; He heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.
text.WEB: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

text.KJV: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
text.ASV: The fear of man bringeth a snare; But whoso putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be safe.
text.WEB: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.

text.KJV: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.
text.ASV: Many seek the ruler's favor; But a man's judgment `cometh' from Jehovah.
text.WEB: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.

text.KJV: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
text.ASV: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; And he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
text.WEB: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

text.KJV: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
text.ASV: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; The oracle. The man saith unto Ithiel, unto Ithiel and Ucal:
text.WEB: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

text.KJV: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
text.ASV: Surely I am more brutish than any man, And have not the understanding of a man;
text.WEB: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

text.KJV: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
text.ASV: And I have not learned wisdom, Neither have I the knowledge of the Holy One.
text.WEB: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

text.KJV: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
text.ASV: Who hath ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who hath gathered the wind in his fists? Who hath bound the waters in his garment? Who hath established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou knowest?
text.WEB: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

text.KJV: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
text.ASV: Every word of God is tried: He is a shield unto them that take refuge in him.
text.WEB: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

text.KJV: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
text.ASV: Add thou not unto his words, Lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
text.WEB: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

text.KJV: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
text.ASV: Two things have I asked of thee; Deny me `them' not before I die:
text.WEB: “Two things I have asked of you; don’t deny me before I die:

text.KJV: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
text.ASV: Remove far from me falsehood and lies; Give me neither poverty nor riches; Feed me with the food that is needful for me:
text.WEB: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me;

text.KJV: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
text.ASV: Lest I be full, and deny `thee', and say, Who is Jehovah? Or lest I be poor, and steal, And use profanely the name of my God.
text.WEB: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

text.KJV: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
text.ASV: Slander not a servant unto his master, Lest he curse thee, and thou be held guilty.
text.WEB: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

text.KJV: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
text.ASV: There is a generation that curse their father, And bless not their mother.
text.WEB: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

text.KJV: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
text.ASV: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, And `yet' are not washed from their filthiness.
text.WEB: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

text.KJV: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
text.ASV: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up.
text.WEB: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

text.KJV: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
text.ASV: There is a generation whose teeth are `as' swords, and their jaw teeth `as' knives, To devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
text.WEB: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

text.KJV: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
text.ASV: The horseleach hath two daughters, `crying', Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, `Yea', four that say not, Enough:
text.WEB: “The leach has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough:’

text.KJV: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
text.ASV: Sheol; and the barren womb; The earth that is not satisfied with water; And the fire that saith not, Enough.
text.WEB: Sheol, the barren womb; the earth that is not satisfied with water; and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough.’

text.KJV: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
text.ASV: The eye that mocketh at his father, And despiseth to obey his mother, The ravens of the valley shall pick it out, And the young eagles shall eat it.
text.WEB: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother: the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

text.KJV: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
text.ASV: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, Yea, four which I know not:
text.WEB: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

text.KJV: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
text.ASV: The way of an eagle in the air; The way of a serpent upon a rock; The way of a ship in the midst of the sea; And the way of a man with a maiden.
text.WEB: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent on a rock; the way of a ship in the middle of the sea; and the way of a man with a maiden.

text.KJV: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
text.ASV: So is the way of an adulterous woman; She eateth, and wipeth her mouth, And saith, I have done no wickedness.
text.WEB: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

text.KJV: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
text.ASV: For three things the earth doth tremble, And for four, `which' it cannot bear:
text.WEB: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

text.KJV: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
text.ASV: For a servant when he is king; And a fool when he is filled with food;
text.WEB: For a servant when he is king; a fool when he is filled with food;

text.KJV: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
text.ASV: For an odious woman when she is married; And a handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
text.WEB: for an unloved woman when she is married; and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

text.KJV: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
text.ASV: There are four things which are little upon the earth, But they are exceeding wise:
text.WEB: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

text.KJV: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
text.ASV: The ants are a people not strong, Yet they provide their food in the summer;
text.WEB: the ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

text.KJV: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
text.ASV: The conies are but a feeble folk, Yet make they their houses in the rocks;
text.WEB: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

text.KJV: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
text.ASV: The locusts have no king, Yet go they forth all of them by bands;
text.WEB: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

text.KJV: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
text.ASV: The lizard taketh hold with her hands, Yet is she in kings' palaces.
text.WEB: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

text.KJV: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
text.ASV: There are three things which are stately in their march, Yea, four which are stately in going:
text.WEB: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

text.KJV: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
text.ASV: The lion, which is mightiest among beasts, And turneth not away for any;
text.WEB: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

text.KJV: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
text.ASV: The greyhound; the he-goat also; And the king against whom there is no rising up.
text.WEB: the greyhound, the male goat also; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

text.KJV: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
text.ASV: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, Or if thou hast thought evil, `Lay' thy hand upon thy mouth.
text.WEB: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

text.KJV: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
text.ASV: For the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, And the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood; So the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
text.WEB: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood; so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

text.KJV: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
text.ASV: The words of king Lemuel; the oracle which his mother taught him.
text.WEB: The words of king Lemuel; the revelation which his mother taught him.

text.KJV: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
text.ASV: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?
text.WEB: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

text.KJV: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
text.ASV: Give not thy strength unto women, Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
text.WEB: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

text.KJV: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
text.ASV: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; Nor for princes `to say', Where is strong drink?
text.WEB: It is not for kings, Lemuel; it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

text.KJV: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
text.ASV: Lest they drink, and forget the law, And pervert the justice `due' to any that is afflicted.
text.WEB: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

text.KJV: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
text.ASV: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, And wine unto the bitter in soul:
text.WEB: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish; and wine to the bitter in soul:

text.KJV: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
text.ASV: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.
text.WEB: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

text.KJV: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
text.ASV: Open thy mouth for the dumb, In the cause of all such as are left desolate.
text.WEB: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

text.KJV: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
text.ASV: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, And minister justice to the poor and needy.
text.WEB: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

text.KJV: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
text.ASV: A worthy woman who can find? For her price is far above rubies.
text.WEB: form an acrostic, with each verse starting with each letter of the Hebrew alphabet, in order.Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.

text.KJV: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
text.ASV: The heart of her husband trusteth in her, And he shall have no lack of gain.
text.WEB: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

text.KJV: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
text.ASV: She doeth him good and not evil All the days of her life.
text.WEB: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

text.KJV: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
text.ASV: She seeketh wool and flax, And worketh willingly with her hands.
text.WEB: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

text.KJV: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
text.ASV: She is like the merchant-ships; She bringeth her bread from afar.
text.WEB: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

text.KJV: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
text.ASV: She riseth also while it is yet night, And giveth food to her household, And their task to her maidens.
text.WEB: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

text.KJV: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
text.ASV: She considereth a field, and buyeth it; With the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
text.WEB: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

text.KJV: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
text.ASV: She girdeth her loins with strength, And maketh strong her arms.
text.WEB: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

text.KJV: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
text.ASV: She perceiveth that her merchandise is profitable: Her lamp goeth not out by night.
text.WEB: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

text.KJV: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
text.ASV: She layeth her hands to the distaff, And her hands hold the spindle.
text.WEB: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

text.KJV: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
text.ASV: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; Yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
text.WEB: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

text.KJV: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
text.ASV: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; For all her household are clothed with scarlet.
text.WEB: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

text.KJV: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
text.ASV: She maketh for herself carpets of tapestry; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
text.WEB: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

text.KJV: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
text.ASV: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sitteth among the elders of the land.
text.WEB: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

text.KJV: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
text.ASV: She maketh linen garments and selleth them, And delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
text.WEB: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

text.KJV: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
text.ASV: Strength and dignity are her clothing; And she laugheth at the time to come.
text.WEB: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

text.KJV: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
text.ASV: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; And the law of kindness is on her tongue.
text.WEB: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Faithful instruction is on her tongue.

text.KJV: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
text.ASV: She looketh well to the ways of her household, And eateth not the bread of idleness.
text.WEB: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

text.KJV: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
text.ASV: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; Her husband `also', and he praiseth her, `saying':
text.WEB: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

text.KJV: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
text.ASV: Many daughters have done worthily, But thou excellest them all.
text.WEB: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

text.KJV: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
text.ASV: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; `But' a woman that feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.
text.WEB: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

text.KJV: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
text.ASV: Give her of the fruit of her hands; And let her works praise her in the gates.
text.WEB: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
